view: three-quarter, facing right (mirror for facing left)
pivot: feet centre, 4 px above the cell bottom (bust variants: centre of the cut edge)

blink.note: only while the still idle is shown (the video idle blinks by itself)

gesture.note: PlayGesture: hold, then return to idle (no in-betweens)

switching: Start talking only at a video idle loop boundary (cell 0 matches the still idle pose; aligned to the still pivot) or cross-fade ~80 ms; video cells are slightly softer than the stills.
notes: S66 school garden shed, December 1982 (outdoors, winter coat, gloves, knitted cap). Magenta key (green coat). 'metre dreva' read as a wooden folding rule.
